chunk_map.heading: Sharpen the insights, never the sources

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L10 'Keep the transcript as it was': 'the transcript' resolves to L6 'the interview transcripts' in the same chunk; 'the agent' (L7, L10) and 'the rules file' (L8) are each named before use. Closest: L4 'The team's folder' is introduced by the slide itself. No pronoun without an in-chunk antecedent.
grep body L1-11 for 'lecture|opening|earlier|module|slide' -> no positional pointer to another file; closest L4 'The team's folder' is self-introduced, not a callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward reference in body L1-11

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/reveal or demo beat; static three-layer description, every sentence verbed

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'The team's folder has three layers, kept apart on purpose.' plus L10 'Let the agent rewrite a source and you lose the evidence a claim was built on.' carry a self-contained claim; 114 body words.

L1 'Sharpen the insights, never the sources' vs L7 insight pages 'rewrites and sharpens' and L6 sources 'Nobody edits them': header is literally true of the chunk; closest L8 rules file is neither, but it is the third layer, not a contradiction.

Sub-items: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' (grep 'Not ' -> 0); no anaphora triple (three bullets open with distinct bold nouns, each with new content); no self-grading superlative; no number+retraction; no abstraction-noun stack; no verb triplet. Closest L10 'Keep the transcript as it was, and any insight can still be traced back to who said it' is one declarative with concrete payoff.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep body for 'surface|firing|compendium|forcing function|beat|mood' -> 0. Closest L7 'Insight pages' and L8 'The rules file' are ordinary working-folder terms an engineer or PM in the room uses.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6-8 bold = '**Sources:**', '**Insight pages:**', '**The rules file:**': three bolded elements, each 2-3 words (handle cap respected, labels only, not the sentences after them), naming the three coined layer terms the slide defines (checklist-item/coined-term handles; no narrative bold). Maintainer block L16 attests 'Bold marks the three layer names only'. Closest to violating is the count (3 > 1) on a non-law slide; stays inside because the three names are the slide's enumerated handles and the bold is not on lead sentences. Harm (pre-2026-07-09 monoculture of bolded sentences) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -rl 'sharpen-insights-not-sources' curriculum --exclude-dir=evals -> curriculum/lectures/apt101-your-material-is-the-moat.md and slides/the-door-you-dont-open.md reference it; file is a slide file (slide_count 1, '<!--slide:sharpen-insights-not-sources-->'), so it enters the deck through the lecture include, not as a phase-less prose section. Whether the include is a [T](slides/...) line was not opened here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/sharpen-insights-not-sources.md -> 'OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.' exit 0; no Phase/Step headers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/sharpen-insights-not-sources.md -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body (has_urls false; grep ']\(' -> 0)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/sharpen-insights-not-sources.md -> 'oversized: 0 ... every slide is within limits' exit 0; 3 bullets, ~114 words.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 '## Sharpen the insights, never the sources' is a lecture-style claim (imperative rule with a contrast), the shape the rule asks of lecture headings; not an exercise heading, so no phase-label/imperative requirement is missed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Per bullet: L6 sources, L7 insight pages, L8 rules file each name a distinct object. Closest L10 'Keep the transcript as it was, and any insight can still be traced back to who said it' could read as (c) kicker restating 'Nobody edits them'; stays inside because it adds the consequence (traceability to the speaker) not stated in any bullet, and sits in a paragraph that gives the header's reason. No (a) restatement, no (b) design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer L14 says the slide was retitled for the trio from Agents 101; header L1 'Sharpen the insights, never the sources' covered: promise is 'insights get rewritten, sources never do'. Uncovered body: L6 sources untouched, L7 insights rewritten, L8 rules file (how updates keep shape), L10 why sources stay raw. Every bullet answers the new header; none inherited from the old three-layers-one-folder job.

notes: Single-chunk slide file. Accept-note found: L14 STATUS (first cut, simulation training); L16 Guard names bold on three layer names. Rule 10 link into a deck confirmed only by grep of referencing files, not by rendering.
